description: This file is an HTML document that provides the user interface for a database visualizer or browser. It includes structured layout, styles, and JavaScript code to fetch database names, tables, and data, and display them interactively.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases from the backend API.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by re-fetching from the API and resets the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables; fetches tables if necessary.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table, limited to 50 records.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data as an HTML table with interactive cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell content, supporting nulls, objects, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full or truncated content.
